$Comment: The shield the Headless Horseman wears while his head is flying and nothing can hurt him: the game's own boss shield, the look its Feastmaster wears while it feeds (Dungeon_Feastmaster_Invulnerable), a glowing bubble round him, a ring of shields turning about it and a tint over his body. His fight's script puts it on him as his head flies off (Macro_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Head, ShieldEffect) and takes it off with Root_Hallows_Eve_Horseman_Clear_Shield when the head is cut down or flies back, when his wrath begins and when the fight resets. It only changes how he looks: the script makes him invulnerable on its own. Duration is a backstop in case nothing takes it off, so keep it a little over the longest HeadSeconds. Scale sizes the bubble and the ring, and PositionOffset Y lifts each from his feet to about his middle.
